pages.title: Description
pages.text: Whenever the player picks up stone, there is a chance for the blacksmith familiar to repair their equipment a little bit.$(br2)$(bold)Upgrade Behaviour$(): $(br)Cannot be upgraded, but upgrades other Familiars.$(br)

pages.title: Upgrading Familiars
pages.text: To upgrade other familiars the blacksmith needs to be given iron ingots or blocks by $(#ad03fc)right-clicking$() it.$(br2)Upgraded familiars provide additional effects.$(br)
